name: Colorado Trail Day 5: Breckenridge → Searle Pass
description: Getting to the real mountains now and even some trails I've run before. Late start to soak in the real bed at Bivvi and do a quick resupply, plus I just missed the bus so it was a hot start but the clouds came in just as I hit treeline so not too bad. Three days of food to get me to Twin Lakes. Still brought too much SPENCER however much food you think you need bring 30% less. Legs are feeling great on the uphills so made very good time up Tenmile. Feeling a bit more tender on the downhill. Copper closed part of the trail so rerouted through the resort. Feels great to set your tarp up mere seconds before the thunderstorm hits! I'm really only sleeping a couple hours a night though which is rough
